name: KnowledgeNode
description: Plan-57 — a chunked + embedded fragment of a knowledge source file. One row per chunk. Scoped to a KnowledgeContainer: SELECT ... WHERE knowledge_container_id = ?. A container is the namespace (e.g., '737 Knowledge', '767 Knowledge'); an agent consumes one or more containers via downstream wiring. Re-ingest = delete existing nodes for fileId and re-chunk. Future KnowledgeLink will reference node ids to form a graph. Ingestion (chunking + embedding) is deferred from V1 (will run as an async function via the scheduler); V1 ships the table + indexes so writes from the future ingestion pipeline land cleanly. ACL is read-only via generic CRUD: node lifecycle is owned by the ingestion pipeline (KnowledgeNodeService); direct CRUD would corrupt the embedding index.

attributes.name: appId
attributes.description: Plan-57 — app this node belongs to. Stamped at ingest; immutable. SA-mode rows take the DDL default (0); MA-mode rows take the request's appId.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: Owner — typically the user who uploaded the source file. representsOwnership drives the ownership filter.

attributes.name: knowledgeContainerId
attributes.description: Plan-57 — FK to KnowledgeContainer.id. The container is the retrieval namespace (e.g., one container per topic). Queries scope by 'WHERE knowledge_container_id = ?'. An agent may consume multiple containers, and a container may serve multiple agents — the binding lives outside this table.

attributes.name: fileId
attributes.description: Plan-57 — FK to the raw source File2 row this chunk was derived from. Re-ingest a file = DELETE WHERE file_id = ? then re-chunk.

attributes.name: chunkIndex
attributes.description: Plan-57 — position of this chunk within the source file (0-based). Used to reconstruct ordering and for de-dup when re-ingesting.

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: Plan-57 — the chunk's textual content. What gets returned to the model along with the matched neighbors at retrieval time.

attributes.name: embeddingText
attributes.description: Plan-58 slice 58-B.3.3 — the text actually embedded into the 'embedding' column, when distinct from 'text'. NULL = the 'text' column itself was embedded (the case for default processingMode). Populated when processingMode='prompt' returns chunks whose LLM-supplied embeddingText differs from text — e.g., a passage's text plus a Q/A reframe used purely for retrieval. Stored for debuggability + re-embed traceability.

attributes.name: embedding
attributes.description: Plan-57 — pgvector embedding (gemini text-embedding-004 = 768 dimensions). HNSW index on the cosine operator class for similarity retrieval (<=> operator). Same shape as AgentMemory.embedding.

attributes.name: metadata
attributes.description: Plan-57 — free-form chunk metadata (page number, section heading, language, source URL, ...). Caller-supplied at ingest; not validated server-side.
